claims.claim_text: The TruFor image-level manipulation score is 0.999.
claims.brief_justification: Detector numeric output; not verifiable from the supplied imagery.

claims.claim_text: The probability for the central region is 1.0.
claims.brief_justification: Reported numeric value; the supplied mask is binary and carries no probability values.

The mask in image C is a giraffe-shaped silhouette whose bulk sits in the middle-center cell, extending into bottom-center and up-right into center-right; image D outlines the same shape with its centroid in the centre cell.

claims.claim_text: These measurements suggest significant digital manipulation.
claims.brief_justification: The outlined centre region in image D contains a giraffe whose torso is replaced by flat saturated cyan/teal/blue and black blocky patches with smeared vertical striations - no reticulated coat, no cast shadow, hard rectangular cut edges, and a body that does not connect coherently to neck or legs. Image B shows an ordinary patterned giraffe in that position.

notes: Very short explanation. Its location claim matches the mask and its manipulation conclusion is strongly corroborated by the visible anomaly in D and by the A-vs-B difference. It is scored only partially supported because it names no object and describes none of the actual visual evidence, resting instead on reported detector numbers that cannot be audited.
